recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Use DetectedIssue.code for v3 ActCode CAREGAP in the current model; re-adding CAREGAP to DetectedIssue.category would undo FHIR-39458 and should require a new CDS work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-27910 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request for R5 asking to add a care-gap code to the Detected Issue Category value set because Gaps in Care Reporting was using DetectedIssue with a fixed care-gap code.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-27910. The same issue family initially satisfied the request: UP-175 added v3 ActCode CAREGAP under _ClinicalActionDetectedIssueCode, and FHIR-39309 implemented FHIR-31677 by adding _ClinicalActionDetectedIssueCode to the FHIR DetectedIssueCategory value set before R5 publication.
additional_context: FHIR-39458 later made an Applied/Persuasive R6 decision that DetectedIssue.code should not be bound to the Detected Issue Category value set. Its implementation created a separate DetectedIssue Code value set for detailed issue codes and restricted DetectedIssue Category to category-level codes.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/fhir.ini lists detectedissue as an active resource; DetectedIssue.category binds to the restricted category value set, and DetectedIssue.code binds to DetectedIssueCode, whose compose includes _ClinicalActionDetectedIssueCode and therefore the CAREGAP detailed code.
